description: This file contains implementation of a generic class 'FrequentItemCollection' used for tracking frequent items in data streams, along with a specialized class 'FrequentEdgeCounter' that extends it to count edges with source and target nodes. It implements a space-saving algorithm for top-k element detection, including heap management and sketch-based frequency estimation.

classes.name: FrequentEdgeCounter
classes.description: A specialized class for counting edges with source and target nodes, extending 'FrequentItemCollection' with 'ulong' keys.

classes.name: FrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A generic class implementing a space-saving algorithm for tracking top-k frequent items in data streams, using a heap and sketch for frequency estimation.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Computes a unique key for an 'Edge' based on source and target node hash codes.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the collection, resetting internal data structures.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item based on its key.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an element to the collection, updating counts or inserting new entries.

methods.name: RemoveCore
methods.description: Internal method to remove an item by key, updating heap and sketch.

methods.name: ClearCore
methods.description: Internal method to clear internal data structures.

methods.name: InsertHeap
methods.description: Inserts a new counter into the heap.

methods.name: GrowHeap
methods.description: Resizes the heap array to accommodate more elements.

methods.name: MoveUpHeap
methods.description: Restores heap order by moving a node up.

methods.name: MoveDownHeap
methods.description: Restores heap order by moving a node down.

methods.name: GetSketchSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the sketch array based on capacity.
